newsitem.title: UK: UK's GWR reports 14.3 mln stg pretax profits.
newsitem.headline: UK's GWR reports 14.3 mln stg pretax profits.

text.p: Riding on the back of its entry into the UK's national broadcasting market through Classic FM, radio operator GWR Group Plc reported on Wednesday pre-tax profits of 14.3 million stg in the 18-month period to March, 1997.

GWR, which also operates news and information stations LBC and News Direct, has changed its financial year to end of March. Its proforma pretax profits in 12 months to March 1997 rose to 12 million stg from 5.5 million, it said.
The proforma profits included profits on disposals of 4.5 million stg with earnings per share rising to 8.9 pence share from 6.3 pence. GWR proposed a final dividend of 1.25 pence per share.
The company acquired Classic FM last August for 83 million stg and has since then reorganised the company to improve earnings.

GWR also announced the sale of business and assets of 96.6FM, one of its radio stations, and the St Albans and Watford Broadcasting Company Ltd, a dormant company which holds the broadcasting licence.
GWR sold it to Essex Radio Plc for 725,175 stg comprising 450,000 stg in cash and 18,345 shares in Independent Radio News (IRN) at 15 stg each.
The company's stake in IRN will go up to 7.3 percent.
